bullets.text: A rashly driven MTC bus killed a woman on her way to a hospital near Puzhal, and the office should monitor bus safety enforcement.
Two women were killed in separate road crashes involving buses near Puzhal and Nazarethpet, prompting traffic units to arrest the drivers.
Police registered a case against two female wardens in Chennai and Nagercoil for harassing a plus-one student, and the office should track the investigation.
Two accused in a petty shop owner murder case were detained under the Goondas Act in Puzhal jail, and the office should monitor law and order.
The cooperative special store in Sengundram started distributing Deepavali grocery kits, and the office should watch the distribution process.
Fishermen in Thiruvallur are banned from going to sea due to a rocket launch from Sriharikota, and the office should ensure safety compliance.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 125 crore to roll out a scheme for AI assistive devices for persons with disability, which the office should review.
CBSE dropped computational thinking and AI modules from the Class 9 curriculum for the 2026-27 batch, and the portfolio team should note this educational shift.
The Supreme Court directed MeitY to enforce restrictions on the unauthorised use of court proceedings, and the office should watch ministry compliance.
